definitions.gloss: every month; monthly; month by month
definitions.explanation: Each successive month, on a month-by-month basis. Used both as a noun and adverbially, most often for recurring payments or amounts.

examples.japanese: {月々|つきづき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支払|しはら}い。
{月々|つきづき}⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Save a fixed amount every month.

examples.japanese: ⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{月々|つきづき}⟦{三|さん}{万|まん}→三万：30467_sanman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{返|かえ}している→返す：09648_kaesu⟧。
examples.english: I'm paying back the loan at 30,000 yen a month.

notes:
Written with the iteration mark 々; the second ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧ is voiced to づき through {連濁|れんだく} (sequential voicing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月々|つきづき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支払|しはら}い: monthly payment
- {月々|つきづき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧: monthly repayment
- {月々|つきづき}⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧: monthly installments

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧: every month — more neutral and common
- {月々|つきづき} emphasizes the steady, month-after-month recurrence, especially of payments and savings.
